origins.section: 5.1. On a BASE I Link, a Header Sits Between the Length and the MTI
5.2. A Rejected Message Comes Back Behind a Longer Header, With No Field 39
5.3. The MTI and the Processing Code Together Name the Transaction
5.4. A Private Field Can Hold a Message of Its Own, Laid Out by This Release's Specification

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-frame-length: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-frame-length: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-frame-length: Section 5.1 shows the prefix 0044 (68) counts header and message and header byte 16 means 22, so 0x3A = 58 and 58 - 22 = 36.
recorded.prompt:q-own-mti-back: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-own-mti-back: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-own-mti-back: Section 5.2 says to check the header for a reject before field 39 and log the reject code, since no issuer saw the message.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-return: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-return: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-return: Section 5.3 says a merchant taking back items a week later sends a refund with its own amount and STAN.
recorded.prompt:q-flat-private-field: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flat-private-field: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flat-private-field: Section 5.4 says the receiver reads field 126 as a bitmap and sub-fields, finds six bytes where eight are needed, and fails.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-frame-length:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-frame-length:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-frame-length:a: Section 5.1 labels the prefix 'length 68 (header and message)', so it is not the message alone.
recorded.prompt:q-frame-length:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-frame-length:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-frame-length:b: Section 5.1 counts the header in the 68 and not the four prefix bytes (72 on the wire, length 68).
recorded.prompt:q-frame-length:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-frame-length:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-frame-length:d: Section 5.1 shows 72 bytes on the wire against a length of 68, so the prefix's own four bytes are not counted.
recorded.prompt:q-own-mti-back:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-own-mti-back:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-own-mti-back:a: Section 5.2 names reporting it as a decline as the mistake, since no issuer has seen the purchase.
recorded.prompt:q-own-mti-back:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-own-mti-back:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-own-mti-back:c: Section 5.2 says the same broken field is rejected again and the reject code points at the field to fix (its reason clause is true, its action is refuted).
recorded.prompt:q-own-mti-back:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-own-mti-back:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-own-mti-back:d: Section 5.2 says the header carries the network's reject code and no issuer saw the message.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-return:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-return:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-return:a: Section 5.3 says a reversal points back at a message whose outcome is still open, and the purchase has been cleared.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-return:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-return:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-return:b: Section 5.3 answers a return after clearing with a refund, a new transaction, not a reversal.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-return:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-return:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-return:c: Section 5.3 says a refund is a new transaction, not an undo, with its own STAN.
recorded.prompt:q-flat-private-field:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flat-private-field:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flat-private-field:b: Section 5.4 says the six characters pack without complaint, as 06 and six ASCII bytes, so nothing is cut.
recorded.prompt:q-flat-private-field:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flat-private-field:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flat-private-field:c: Section 5.4 shows the flat value goes out as plain bytes with no sub-field bitmap and fails to unpack.
recorded.prompt:q-flat-private-field:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flat-private-field:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flat-private-field:d: Section 5.4 says some private fields hold a message with its own bitmap, 126 among them, and the flat value fails at the receiver.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
each of the 4 questions cites a passage the ledger still digests to the value this exercise was built from
